Ethan Brooks: Quick one — taxi on corpcard in Santorini on 2026-05-12 for airport transfer. Charge shows €48.00 and the receipt email I got is just a short PDF with no VAT number. Policy needs VAT invoice for EU expenses >€40. Any fast way to get a vendor invoice?
Marta Lopez: Did the driver provide a printed receipt? sometimes the local taxi companies email a proper invoice if you ask.
Ethan Brooks: I only have the ephemeral PDF from the hotel concierge (says 'Taxi transfer' + amount), no vendor VAT. I paid with card (last4 7890).
FinanceBot: Reminder: For EU VAT reclaim we require vendor invoice with VAT number for amounts >€40, OR manager approval + reasonable attempt to obtain vendor invoice. Missing VAT may not be reclaimable.
Priya Rao: @Ethan can you upload the PDF and paste the transaction id? We can try contacting the vendor via the hotel or payment processor. If not available, manager sign-off will allow expense but EU VAT won't be reclaimed.
Ethan Brooks: Uploaded: https://files.redwood.com/receipts/santorini_taxi_20260512_7890.pdf. Transaction ID TXN-1a2b3c attached to expense notes.
Marco Rossi: I approve this — client dinner ended late, trusted transfer arranged by concierge. I'm happy to sign-off for reimbursement.
Marta Lopez: Thanks. I'll attempt vendor contact via the payment processor with TXN-1a2b3c. If they can't provide VAT invoice, we'll process reimbursement but flag for non-reclaimable VAT.
Priya Rao: Checklist: receipt uploaded, txn id present, manager approval present. Good to go for reimbursement. Tagging for next payments run.
Ethan Brooks: Appreciate it. If you need me to chase the taxi company I can, but concierge said they rarely issue formal invoices.
FinanceBot: Expense queued (ID 2026-EXP-901). Note: VAT reclaim status pending vendor reply.
